source_title: Sri Lanka Vs England Match Score
source_excerpt: Rathnayake nearly does it again - After losing an early wicket, skipper Kusal Mendis took matters into his own hands and counter-attacked brilliantly alongside Avishka Fernando. The duo put on 84 runs for the second wicket before Fernando was dismissed. Mendis then built another solid stand with Pavan Rathnayake, this time worth 80 runs before getting dismissed. Rathnayake attacked from one end and got some support from the likes of Janith Liyanage and Sahan Arachchige and brought up his second consecutive ton against England. However, with wickets falling around him and the pressure mounting, Rathnayake gave away his wicket to Dawson, who was in his final over, and maybe Rathnayake could have let him bowl out. But it is a tough one, as at that time, he had tailenders at the other end, so you can't fault him much.. Dawson stars with the ball - England came into this contest on the back of three straight defeats, and in all three of those matches, you feel that they let things slip and had only themselves to blame. Today as well, it looked like they would fumble with the ball, but Liam Dawson saved Harry Brook and his side from the blemishes. Sonny Baker started off well with an early wicket, but it was Dawson who broke a brewing second-wicket stand, and then went on to pick up the wickets of Dasun Shanaka and Pavan Rathnayake, both of whom were match-winners for Sri Lanka in their last meeting. Overall, England still have work to do with the ball and in the field as well, but will be very ecstatic to finish with a win.. England end on a positive - Another cracking contest between England and Sri Lanka, but this time England come out on top in this high-scoring encounter. Sri Lanka gave it their all, but 387 was always going to be very tough to chase down. Overall, England might be out of the final, but they will take this win and try to build on it.
